# Idle expiry, and an exec whose outcome is unknown. An unknown session
# blocks expiry; an idle environment without one is deleted.

env-domain D
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env create -f busy.yaml --request-id busy-1 --request-domain $D
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env create -f idle.yaml --request-id idle-1 --request-domain $D
env-id B busy
env-id I idle
env-reconcile

! skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env exec $B -- lost
stderr 'command outcome unknown; it was not resent'
! skygo --json --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env exec $B -- lost
stdout '^\{\}$'
stderr 'command outcome unknown; it was not resent'
# A refused command is still reported unknown: no status proves it never ran.
! skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env exec $B -- refused
stderr 'exec outcome unknown; it was not resent'
stderr 'unavailable'
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env get $B
stdout '^'$B' +busy +modeled +present +ready +0 +[1-8]$'

env-advance 301s
env-reconcile
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env get $B
stdout '^'$B' +busy +modeled +present +ready '
skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env get $I
stdout '^'$I' +idle +modeled +absent +deleted '
skygo --json --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env get $I
stdout '"expired": *true'

-- busy.yaml --
name: busy
target: modeled
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 100
memory_bytes: 1048576
idle_timeout_seconds: 300
-- idle.yaml --
name: idle
target: modeled
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 100
memory_bytes: 1048576
idle_timeout_seconds: 300
